text_1981: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them terrible retribution.
text_1989: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them a whipping retribution.

text_1981: Your Lord is ever watchful. 15.
text_1989: Your Lord is ever watchful.
text_ref: Your Lord is ever watchful.

text_1981: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, "My Lord is generous towards me."
text_1989: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, “My Lord is generous towards me.”
text_ref: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, "My Lord is generous towards me."

text_1981: But if He tests him through reduction in provisions, he says, "My Lord is humiliating me!"
text_1989: But if He tests him through reductioi in provisions, he says, “My Lord is humiliating me!”
text_ref: But if He tests him through reduction in provisions, he says, "My Lord is humiliating me!"

text_1981: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.
text_1989: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.
text_ref: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.

text_1981: Nor do you exhort each other to feed the poor.
text_1989: And not advocating charity towards the poor.
text_ref: And not advocating charity towards the poor.

text_1981: You unlawfully consume the (orphan's) inheritance.
text_1989: And consuming the inheritance of helpless orphans.
text_ref: And consuming the inheritance of helpless orphans.

text_1981: You love money too much. . 21 Indeed, the earth will be demolished; totally crushed. As your Lord comes,* together with the angels in row after row. Hell will be brought forth on that day.
text_1989: And loving the money too much.
text_ref: And loving the money too much.

text_1981: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.
text_1989: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.
text_ref: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.

text_1981: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.
text_1989: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.
text_ref: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.

text_1981: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.
text_1989: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.
text_ref: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.

text_1981: He will say, "Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life."
text_1989: He will say, “Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life.”
text_ref: He will say, "Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life."

text_1981: On that day, the retribution is worst.
text_1989: On that day, no retribution could be worse than His retribution.
text_ref: On that day, no retribution could be worse than His retribution.

text_1981: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.
text_1989: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.
text_ref: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.

text_1981: As for you, secure and content soul.
text_1989: As for you, O content soul.
text_ref: As for you, O content soul.

text_1981: Come back to your Lord, satisfied and satisfying.
text_1989: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.
text_ref: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.

text_1981: Enter with My servants.
text_1989: Welcome into My servants.
text_ref: Welcome into My servants.
